title: Pearl-Chat: Engineering a native Luganda language model from first principles in JAX and Flax NNX
abstract: arXiv:2610.22529v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autoregressive foundation language models predominantly target high-resource Indo-European languages, imposing computational and morphological penalties on under-represented African languages. Generic multilingual tokenizers routinely exceed fertility rates of 3.2 tokens per word on agglutinative Bantu languages, degrading context efficiency and inflating latency. We present Pearl-Chat, an 8,473,122-parameter ($\sim$8.5M) causal decoder-only transformer engineered for Luganda (Oluganda, ISO 639-2: lg), a low-resource Niger-Congo Bantu language spoken by over 10 million people in East Africa. Built from first mathematical principles in JAX and Flax NNX, Pearl-Chat uses explicit functional state decomposition (nnx.split and nnx.merge), deterministic resumable data streaming via Google Grain, and SPMD tensor parallelism using jax.sharding.Mesh. We introduce a byte-level byte-pair encoding (BPE) subword tokenizer trained from scratch on cura

translated_title: Pearl-Chat：基于 JAX 和 Flax NNX 从第一性原理构建的卢干达语原生语言模型
translated_abstract: 自回归基础语言模型主要面向高资源的印欧语言，这对代表性不足的非洲语言造成了计算和形态学上的不利影响。通用的多语言分词器在黏着语类型的班图语言上，每词的子词切分率通常会超过3.2个词元，从而降低了上下文利用效率并增加了推理延迟。我们提出了Pearl-Chat，一个拥有8,473,122个参数（约850万）的因果解码器式Transformer，专为卢干达语（Oluganda，ISO 639-2: lg）设计——这是一种在东非被超过1000万人使用的低资源尼日尔-刚果语系班图语言。Pearl-Chat基于JAX和Flax NNX从第一数学原理构建，采用显式的函数式状态分解（nnx.split和nnx.merge）、通过Google Grain实现的确定性可恢复数据流式加载，以及使用jax.sharding.Mesh的SPMD张量并行。我们引入了一个在精选语料库上从头训练的字节级字节对编码（BPE）子词分词器……
tldr: 该论文提出了Pearl-Chat——一个用JAX和Flax NNX从第一性原理构建的约850万参数卢干达语原生因果语言模型，通过从头训练的字节级BPE分词器解决了通用多语言分词器在班图黏着语言上子词切分率过高的问题。
en_tdlr: The paper presents Pearl-Chat, a native ~8.5M-parameter Luganda causal language model built from first principles in JAX and Flax NNX, featuring a from-scratch byte-level BPE tokenizer to overcome the high token fertility of generic multilingual tokenizers on agglutinative Bantu languages.
